findings.quote: a 0.2 M solution of NaOH which had been saturated with solid  NaCl  (30  mL)
findings.message: The 30 mL quantity describes the NaCl-saturated NaOH solution, not solid NaCl. The plan incorrectly leaves this solution volume unassigned.

findings.quote: the mixture was poured into a 0.2 M solution of NaOH which had been saturated with solid  NaCl  (30  mL)  and  EtOAc  (50  mL)
findings.message: The workup additions and transfer lack vessel routing. The source specifies transfer of the reaction mixture into a recipient containing the workup liquids, rather than addition of those liquids to the reactor.

findings.quote: An analytical portion of the product 5f was triturated with hot EtOAc / hexanes
findings.message: The final purification step must be scoped to an analytical portion, not the entire isolated product. The evidence preserves this distinction, but it is not otherwise represented in the plan.

patch.value: a 0.2 M solution of NaOH which had been saturated with solid  NaCl  (30  mL)
“a 0.2 M solution of NaOH which had been saturated with solid  NaCl  (30  mL)” specifies 30 mL of the NaCl-saturated NaOH solution; it does not specify the amount of solid NaCl.

“An analytical portion of the product 5f was triturated with hot EtOAc / hexanes”: the final trituration applies only to an analytical portion, not the bulk product. The portion amount and its vessel are unspecified.
